banner.title: The Alchemist, complete - Jon Pickens' new D&D character class (folios 28-30): the class frame, the twenty-stage advancement ladder, the four ability percentages, the six-level potions grid, the level-gated abilities, the On Poisons doctrine, and the laboratory
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 2 (August 1976): folios 28-30, Jon Pickens' A New D&D Character Class: The Alchemist - the class core and ability table (folio 28), the potions list, acids, drugs, production costs and the new-potion explanations (folio 29), and the magic-item interactions, the On Poisons doctrine, and the weapon damage option (folio 30, the option rides a later round). COMPLETE per the user's mandate - class, progression, potions and poisons, no cherry-picking. OD&D-era ink converted per the walk doctrine: the pin IS the conversion, noted, never silent.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. The Alchemist rides as a full variant class - the engine's canon classes are untouched; the two printed grids (the four ability percentages, the potions per level) and the twenty-stage XP ladder are pinned as printed, with the ink's blank ceiling cells read as the 100-percent cap and so noted; the level-gated abilities, the poison level-strength system, the acids, drugs and blade venom, the production costs, and the item interactions (Grimoire of Archaic Alchemy, Book of Infinite Spells, the Philosopher's Stone) all ride noted, never silent.

audit_comment: THE ALCHEMIST, COMPLETE - Round B of issue 2 (folios 28-30, Jon Pickens), the full variant class on the variant layer. THE CLASS FRAME (folio 28): human, neutral, both Wisdom and Intelligence over 12 (converted to the 13 floor, noted), best armor class 5, d6 hit dice to level 9 then one point a level, attacks as Clerics with one-handed weapons, saves as Fighters plus 2 vs poison and non-magical paralyzation, psionics as Fighters with Molecular Agitation for Body Weaponry, any potion, the Manual of Golems, the Jug of Plentiful Potions control. THE LADDER (folio 28): twenty stages Student 0 XP through Master Alchemist the 11th at 1,800,000. THE GRIDS (folio 28): the four ability percentages (Detect Poison, Neutralize Poison, Neutralize Paralyzation, Identify Potion) - 20/10/15/5 at Student to the printed 95s and the 100-percent ceiling where the ink's cells go blank, so noted, never silent; the six-level potions grid - none through Cleric, the columns opening 2 from Scribe, 1 from Savant, 1 from Philosopher, 1 from Alchemist, 1 from Mstr 2nd, 1 from Mstr 4th, to 10/8/8/6/6/4 at the top. THE LEVEL GATES (folio 28): Read Languages 80 percent and poisons and Delusion at 1st, potions and acids at 3rd, Blade Venom at 5th, Read Magic as Thieves at 7th, potions from samples at 9th. THE POISONS DOCTRINE (folios 28, 30): brew at 50 gold a strength level a day; poison at or above the victim's dice kills in 3 rounds on a failed save, at half or more it slows until an hourly constitution check, below that it accumulates; large doses minus 20 percent ingestion per dose, Belladonna half strength, the cleric neutralization option; Blade Venom at 200 gold a week a vial, three coats, dead 24 hours after opening. THE LABORATORY (folios 29-30): acids at 100 gold and a d6 a level with the 15-plus-5-a-level neutralization from 3rd; drugs double cost, saves minus 2, 4 hours down; potions at 200 gold a level with samples plus 40 percent and the 250-gold no-MU option; the forty-two-potion list across six levels with the new-potion explanations; the item interactions - the Grimoire (plus a level, 10,000 MU XP, Clerics 7,000 XP and 5-30 lost, others 2-20), the Book of Infinite Spells 5-20, the Philosopher's Stone (2-8 charges, 20 percent research, 10,000 weight transmuted at 50-50 gold-silver, Cure Disease free, disease and heat immunity, disintegration at the last charge). HONEST BOUNDARIES: a variant class, never core 1e canon - the engine's canon classes are untouched; the blank ceiling cells and the option clauses ride noted, never silent. The Remorhaz box flips this round - the issue-2 report's first flip, 1 closed / 3 open.
